-- 任务：客户渠道汇总（合成示例）
-- 口径：仅统计生效状态的客户
INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mart.channel_summary PARTITION (dt = '${bizdate}')
SELECT
    s.customer_id AS customer_id, -- 客户号
    /* 渠道编码（合成值域） */
    CASE WHEN s.channel_code = 'A' THEN 'ONLINE' ELSE 'OFFLINE' END AS channel_name,
    SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount -- 金额合计（元）
FROM ods.channel_event s
LEFT JOIN dim.channel d ON s.channel_code = d.channel_code -- 按渠道编码补充维度
WHERE s.status = 'ACTIVE' -- 仅生效状态
GROUP BY s.customer_id, CASE WHEN s.channel_code = 'A' THEN 'ONLINE' ELSE 'OFFLINE' END
